articles.title: IT Blocron by Indotype
articles.summary: This document outlines a font's usage agreement, strictly permitting its use for personal projects only. Commercial exploitation is expressly forbidden, and installing the font signifies acceptance of these terms. Adherence to such intellectual property agreements is essential in the digital domain, highlighting the legal frameworks governing creative assets and software usage.

articles.title: At least 15 killed in Russian strike as Zelenskiy announces more peace talks
articles.summary: A Russian drone strike tragically hit a bus carrying mineworkers in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro, killing 15 people, according to Ukrainian emergency services. This incident underscores the devastating civilian toll and humanitarian crisis resulting from the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. For SSB aspirants, it highlights the critical importance of understanding international security dynamics and the profound impact of geopolitical tensions on global stability.
